subject: mathematics
content: Let $$\mathrm{P}_{1}$$ be the plane $$3 x-y-7 z=11$$ and $$\mathrm{P}_{2}$$ be the plane passing through the points $$(2,-1,0),(2,0,-1)$$, and $$(5,1,1)$$. If the foot of the perpendicular drawn from the point $$(7,4,-1)$$ on the line of intersection of the planes $$P_{1}$$ and $$P_{2}$$ is $$(\alpha, \beta, \gamma)$$, then $$\alpha+\beta+\gamma$$ is equal to ___________.
